item: R101 follow-up: Observatory breadth and bulletin country coverage leave quarantined articles out
summary: Open-on-main row 40. distinct_sources (every galaxy's and group's breadth, the Observatory's radius) counted the outlet of a quarantined page as one more independent voice, and the bulletin's country coverage counted its articles and terms; both now take quarantine_scope.not_quarantined (tests red on main). Row 37 (widening ix_mention_date_keyword with article_id) closed as measured and not worth it: 4.8 s and 300 MB of sort memory to build on 5M synthetic mentions (about 12 s and 700 MB projected at 12M, more encrypted) for about 0.2 s per 37-day day-count rebuild; reopens only if a field store shows day counts slow.
